descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-22 steps 1, 4; TFA-92588 AC 10 · “Pre-round tasks appear in the task list”.

Bug N23 · S1 · new

Nursing Home pre-round tasks never appear: Save Note sends no task request, so the list stays 'No tasks yet.'

Tickets: TFA-92588 AC 10 / TFA-92592 AC 14 · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S02 Nursing Home, UAT step 1: tasks dictated in the pre-round appear on the task list

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Tasks dictated in pre-round ('follow up BMP', 'PT eval', 'recheck weight in two weeks') appear on the patient's task list as three open tasks, one each (the precondition the Expected Result's 'the th … (UAT TC-22 step 1; TFA-92588 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician, Nursing Home resident from the fixture, no tasks

When Type the three UAT tasks into the Nursing Home pre-round notes and tap Save Note; open Post-Round → Tasks

Then Three open tasks: follow up BMP, PT eval, recheck weight in two weeks

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT step 4 applied to step 1 (and TFA-92588 AC 10): '3 pending tasks', not 'No tasks yet.' / '0 pending tasks'. Judged on the count only; the per-task regex waits for mustMatch in oracle.mjs and sits in pendingChecks, outside the checkpoint, so nothing is silently skipped (runnerGaps 1). On main the Nursing Home pre-round has no task call (see build), so a Fail is expected; …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)
